messages:
jen: Quick heads-up 1:00 UTC change window tonight. Need an exemption to push embeddings tail-fix (v3.4.3) during the quiet window for EU. Fix reduces 95p tail on long sequences (~2s improvement) but touches the kv-cache invalidation path. Low blast radius: model-service + cache-layer only.

ricardo: Can you paste the rollback playbook here and estimated downtime if we have to revert?

jen: Rollback playbook (short): 1) pin previous image v3.4.2 and reapply (/deploy model-service --image v3.4.2 --pin). 2) run cache rollback script to restore pre-change prefix snapshot (takes ~3-5m). No DB migrations. Estimated customer impact: negligible (<1% request reroute, <1m visible error spike).

sre-lead: Requirements before approving exemption: automated canary (3% -> 20% -> 100%), 12m hold at 20% with health checks, an automatic rollback trigger if p99 latency > baseline + 1.5s for 2 consecutive 5m windows OR error rate > 0.5%. Please confirm observability hooks.

nina: I'll own dashboards. Adding synthetic every 20s and a canary dashboard for `eu.embed.p99`, `eu.embed.kv_miss`. Alert thresholds configured. Ops will be oncall 21:00-22:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Preflight summary:
- pin status: model-service currently pinned v3.4.2
- outstanding incidents: none in last 3h
- canary infra capacity: OK
Preflight OK. Command to run: `/deploy model-service --image v3.4.3-embed-tailfix --pin --canary 3%`

ricardo: Add auto-unpin if trigger fires? we should avoid manual gating in middle of night.

jen: Agree. We'll set an auto-fail timer: if canary fails at any step, auto-unpin to v3.4.2 and run cache-restore. I'll add the script and a pinned message in #ops.

ops-lead: Scheduling note: quiet window 21:00-23:00 UTC. Approve exemption so long as canary and rollback automation present. +1 ops.

jen: Pinned rollback command (will post in ops before deploy):
```
/deploy model-service --image v3.4.2 --pin --force
/scripts/cache_restore.sh --snapshot emb-pre-6823456789
```
Owner: ricardo.

sre-lead: Approved conditional on auto-fail + 12m hold at 20%. Will monitor.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Initiating canary cb-682345. Step 1: 3% live -> starting. Metrics to watch: `eu.embed.p99`, `eu.embed.errors`, `eu.embed.kv_miss_rate`.

jen: Kicking off 21:02 UTC. Nina, please confirm synthetic is green in the next 5m.

nina: Synthetic OK at 21:04 UTC. p99 +0.2s, kv_miss 0.8% (baseline 0.6%). No alerts.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary cb-682345 progressed -> 3% healthy. Advancing to 20% per plan in 10m.

ricardo: Monitoring metrics; I have rollback shortcut ready. If p99 > baseline +1.5s for 2x5m buckets I will trigger.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: 20% steady. Hold timer started for 12m. Current p99 +0.5s, errors flat, kv_miss 1.2%.

jen: Noting in release-log: "v3.4.3: EU embeddings tail latency fix. Rolled out via canary during quiet window with automated rollback and SRE approval."

sre-lead: 12m hold complete, metrics within thresholds. Proceed to 100% in 5m unless objections.

ops-lead: No objections. Proceed.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Advancing to 100%. Rollout completed at 21:28 UTC. No auto-fail triggers.

ricardo: Rolling postmortem-lite: small kv_miss bump during canary that normalized post-rollout. No customer impact. Closing exemption. :tada:
